title: Kavosh project manifest
description: Machine-readable project profile. Read by KavoshStart workflows and agents. Stable facts only — no status.

kavoshStart.description: Exact KavoshStart release tag (vX.Y.Z) for consumer repositories. Reserved value 'self' is valid only for the canonical bagdeli/KavoshStart repository, which executes its checked-out source directly.

visibility.description: Actual repository visibility. Public defaults to standard GitHub-hosted. Private runner choice follows trust, billing, network and workload; private hosted runs require a one-run workflow_dispatch authorization and a manifest never grants it.

tierOverride.description: ADR path if tier differs from CLASSIFICATION.md result

projectKind.description: library = consumed by other Kavosh repositories (classifies at least T1)

adoptionPhase.description: Deprecated legacy migration marker. Consumers of the current standard must not set this to true; it never authorizes enforce:false.

exceptionADR.description: ADR required when a project opts out of KavoshUI.

authorizationADR.description: Required for method=custom; proves equivalent release/security gates.

migrationMode.description: Defaults to expand-contract. maintenance-window is limited to T1 with a migration ADR and per-run owner authorization.

runner.description: Public defaults to standard GitHub-hosted; self-hosted on any visibility requires trustModelADR and same-repository PR gates. Private may choose hosted or isolated self-hosted. Private hosted workflow jobs run only through an owner-initiated workflow_dispatch scoped to an open PR and exact current head; manifest choice alone never authorizes shared quota.

runnerLabels.description: Exact self-hosted labels for this repo: [self-hosted, linux, x64, <repo-slug>] (CI-2)

runners.description: Capacity metric for self-hosted runners registered to this repository; size by queue and SLO, not tier.

monthlyMinutesBudget.description: Portfolio/account planning hint only. It is not a core engineering gate and never grants billable execution.

trustModelADR.description: Required for self-hosted runners. Must document runner trust model, isolation/containment strategy, untrusted-code boundary and credential boundary. Mechanism may be ephemeral/disposable, sandbox/container/rootless/VM, or an equivalently bounded repository-dedicated runner; no single implementation is universal.

requiredWorkflow.description: Optional path of the workflow that exposes the stable `required` aggregate job. Defaults to .github/workflows/ci.yml (or self-check.yml for KavoshStart itself).

prMaxLines.description: Deprecated compatibility field. KavoshStart v2 does not use line/file counts as a merge gate; remove on normal upgrade.

mode.description: Continuous release-scope acceptance/evidence flow. Required for T2 when adopting/upgrading to the current KavoshStart standard.

acceptance.description: Acceptance-flow profile. T2 consumers of the current standard must use mode=continuous; T0/T1 may opt in.

strategy.description: Release implementation strategy. This is an adapter choice, not the release safety contract; all strategies must preserve REL-1/2/5/6.

strategyADR.description: Required for changesets/custom strategies; proves equivalent SemVer, vX.Y.Z immutable tag, exact-source provenance and release gating.

workflow.description: Release workflow adapter. Defaults to .github/workflows/release.yml for release-please; required for non-default release strategies.

command.description: Repository-owned shell command that prepares and builds release assets. Required for release-please artifact packaging when automation.interface is not make; Make consumers may use the default make setup + make package adapter.

items.description: Relative glob under the repository checkout. Absolute paths and parent traversal are forbidden.

paths.description: One or more relative globs whose regular files are attached to the GitHub Release.

artifact.description: Optional default-release artifact adapter. Non-default release strategies own their artifact process in their declared workflow/ADR.

interface.description: Adapter exposing semantic setup/lint/test/build/check operations. The underlying language/tool is not a KavoshStart invariant.
